campaigns.object: Real assistive-technology operation of the exact release candidate
venue_requirements: Named physical or remote device and operating system
Named browser and assistive technology with versions
pass_criteria: All critical tasks are operable without hidden state
No critical or high unresolved accessibility defect
Affected user or accountable representative acceptance is recorded
prohibited_claims: Standing for untested assistive technologies, users, devices, browsers, or tasks

campaigns.object: Human comprehension, uncertainty, authority, refusal, and handoff playtest
venue_requirements: Named session venue
Versioned task script and participant role
pass_criteria: Representative actors can identify evidence, uncertainty, authority, and refusal
No critical or high unresolved comprehension defect
Acceptance or bounded rejection is recorded
prohibited_claims: Clinical, legal, safety, eligibility, or institutional validation

campaigns.object: Real device, browser, graphics, input, and operating-system matrix
venue_requirements: Named physical devices
Named browsers, operating systems, graphics stack, display, input, and network
pass_criteria: Every required device profile completes the campaign
No critical or high unresolved device-specific defect
Rendered and exported bytes remain within the release boundary
prohibited_claims: Standing for untested devices or operating systems

campaigns.object: Actual slow, intermittent, offline, captive, metered, and recovery network campaign
venue_requirements: Named network path and impairment method
Recorded latency, bandwidth, loss, interruption, and recovery conditions
pass_criteria: Candidate remains bounded and understandable under every required condition
No missing evidence becomes safe or complete
Recovery does not duplicate or corrupt state

campaigns.object: Controlled private projection, identity minimization, consent, refusal, export, and deletion campaign
venue_requirements: Controlled private workspace
Named data-retention and deletion boundary
pass_criteria: Private bytes never enter public artifacts
Consent and refusal remain operative
Export and deletion are independently verified
prohibited_claims: Standing for untested data classes or jurisdictions

campaigns.object: Credential custody, quota, cost, cache, rights, zero-key, outage, and terms campaign
venue_requirements: Approved credential store
Named provider account, budget, quota, rights, and alert boundary
pass_criteria: Secrets never enter retained public artifacts
Missing and failed providers remain explicit
Budget and rights blocks prevent unauthorized operation
prohibited_claims: Standing beyond observed provider account and terms

campaigns.object: Lawful access, safety, observation, work, completion, and affected-actor acceptance campaign
venue_requirements: Named lawful-access venue
Approved safety procedure, equipment, weather, and stop conditions
pass_criteria: Every field claim is tied to a real observation and authority
No public context becomes field truth by inference
Completion and acceptance remain separate receipts
prohibited_claims: Survey, inspection, safety, legal, insurance, or completion standing beyond evidence

campaigns.object: Independent durable archive write, readback, digest, recovery, and account-loss campaign
venue_requirements: Durable archive outside GitHub Actions retention
Independently controlled account or storage path
pass_criteria: Exact bytes and digest survive outside expiring storage
A cold successor can recover without the source account
Archive permissions and sharing state are recorded
prohibited_claims: Independent archive standing from a copy in the same account or ephemeral runner

campaigns.object: Exact public endpoint deployment and observed-byte campaign
venue_requirements: Named public endpoint
Approved release window and immutable candidate archive
pass_criteria: Every observed public byte matches the authorized candidate manifest
No private or held effect is exposed
Rollback target is available and verified
prohibited_claims: Public release from repository state alone
Endpoint standing without observed bytes and release authority

campaigns.object: Real deployed rollback trigger, transition, exact-byte proof, recovery, and acceptance campaign
venue_requirements: The actual public deployment venue
Named rollback trigger, target, and recovery window
pass_criteria: The exact rollback target becomes active
Observed public bytes match its manifest
Service and authority acceptance are recorded
prohibited_claims: Rollback standing from a local simulation
Successful rollback without observed endpoint bytes

may: record operator-supplied actors, venue, procedure, observations, evidence hashes, acceptance, and failure disposition
verify local evidence bytes and deterministic receipts
generate a bounded proposed ledger amendment for separate release-authority review
may_not: perform a physical or human campaign by assertion
invent an operator, venue, procedure, observation, acceptance, or evidence receipt
copy private evidence into the repository or public artifact
mark a campaign passed while required observations or evidence classes are missing
apply an amendment directly to the canonical ledger or authorize public release

claim_boundary: The runner can create, validate, and package evidence supplied by accountable campaign operators. A synthetic test, initialized workspace, successful process exit, or complete form does not prove that a real campaign occurred.
control_question: Can an accountable operator perform one named external campaign, retain every required observation and evidence class, verify exact bytes, record acceptance and failure disposition, and produce a receipt that release authority can review without exposing private evidence or inventing physical standing?
